answer_1.quote: We propose a new encoder‑decoder PLM optimized for abstractive summarization, Z‑Code++, ... The model is evaluated on 13 text summarization tasks across 5 languages ...

answer_2.quote: we report the average F‑measure ROUGE‑2 score of 5 runs. Detailed F‑measure of ROUGE‑1/ROUGE‑2/ROUGE‑L scores can be found ...; BLEU scores are reported for WebNLG and dialog tasks.

answer_4.quote: We submit the test results of XSum to the leaderboard which requires human raters to compare the generated summaries side by side with human written references. ... Z‑Code++ outperforms all the other models ... the human evaluation score is an average of side‑by‑side preference comparison scores.
answer_4.guideline: Raters compare model‑generated summaries with human references in a side‑by‑side setting and indicate their preference.
